symptoms: Pods crashing with OOM errors, memory usage at 95% of limit. Containers getting OOMKilled with exit code 137. Payment processing completely down.
root_cause: Memory limit reduced from 2Gi to 512Mi in deployment configuration as part of cost optimization effort. Application baseline memory requirement is ~800MB.
resolution: Rolled back deployment to previous version with 2Gi memory limit. Created action item to properly load test before changing resource limits.

symptoms: High latency on authentication endpoints, p95 latency increased from 200ms to 3000ms. Database connection pool exhausted. Users experiencing slow logins.
error_messages: Timeout waiting for connection from pool
root_cause: Database connection pool max size reduced from 50 to 10 in configuration change. Traffic spike from mobile app release overwhelmed small pool.
resolution: Increased database connection pool size to 75. Added monitoring for pool utilization. Implemented connection pool metrics alerting.

symptoms: Payment service pods in CrashLoopBackOff state. Application failing to start. Missing environment variables for Stripe API keys. 100% deployment failure.
error_messages: Application failed to start: missing required configuration
root_cause: ConfigMap for payment service accidentally deleted during cleanup of old resources. Environment variables not mounted to pods.
resolution: Recreated ConfigMap with correct Stripe API keys from backup. Restarted deployment. Added protection to prevent accidental deletion of critical ConfigMaps.

symptoms: Intermittent 500 errors on order creation. Error rate spiked to 15%. Orders failing randomly. Database deadlocks detected in logs.
error_messages: Failed to acquire lock on orders table
root_cause: New feature introduced database query with poor locking strategy. Multiple concurrent order creates caused deadlocks. Missing database index on frequently queried column.
resolution: Optimized query to reduce lock contention. Added missing index on order_status column. Implemented retry logic with exponential backoff for deadlock scenarios.

symptoms: Complete service outage. All pods failing health checks. DNS resolution failures. Cannot connect to external SMTP service. Zero successful email sends.
error_messages: Failed to connect to SMTP server
root_cause: CoreDNS configuration change broke DNS resolution for external domains. Only internal cluster DNS working. Caused by typo in CoreDNS ConfigMap during cluster upgrade.
resolution: Reverted CoreDNS ConfigMap to previous working version. Restarted CoreDNS pods. Verified external DNS resolution working. Notification service recovered automatically.

symptoms: API gateway returning 503 errors. Upstream connection failures. Backend services unreachable. Circuit breaker tripped on all routes. Zero successful requests.
root_cause: Network policy accidentally blocked traffic between API gateway and backend services. Policy was too restrictive after security hardening changes. Egress rules missing for backend pod CIDR.
resolution: Updated network policy to allow traffic from API gateway namespace to backend service namespaces. Verified connectivity restored. Added integration tests for network policies.

symptoms: Sudden spike in error rate to 80%. Payments timing out. CPU usage maxed at 100%. Slow query detected in database. Payment processing severely degraded.
error_messages: Slow query detected: SELECT * FROM payments WHERE created_at > NOW()
root_cause: Database migration removed critical index on payments table. Full table scan on every query. Migration was deployed without proper testing on production-sized dataset.
resolution: Emergency rollback of database migration. Recreated missing index. Optimized query to use index hints. Added query performance testing to CI/CD pipeline.

symptoms: Intermittent 429 rate limit errors. Users getting locked out. Redis connection failures. Session storage failing. Authentication working but session persistence broken.
error_messages: Failed to store session: connection error
root_cause: Redis cluster nodes scaled down automatically by HPA during low-traffic period. Connection pool still pointing to old pod IPs. DNS TTL too high causing stale connections.
resolution: Disabled HPA for Redis cluster (stateful service should not autoscale). Configured connection pool to use service DNS name instead of pod IPs. Lowered DNS TTL for Redis service.
